name: Timmendorfer Strand (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and blue in the proportions 1:5:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Timmendorfer Strand (a yellow sailing boat and a seahorse on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Timmendorfer Strand; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Timmendorfer Strand arms — sailing boat and seahorse on blue
